editor.label: World name
editor.description: The save saves/<name>.zip; a missing world is created. Letters, digits, spaces and _, up to 32 characters.

editor.label: Owner player name
editor.description: The player who joins with this name gets owner permissions (commands in the chat). Letters, digits and _.

editor.label: Message of the day
editor.description: Shown to players who join. Up to 200 characters, no double quotes, backslashes or hyphens (-).

editor.label: Java memory (MB)
editor.description: Maximum Java heap of the server.

editor.label: Pause when empty
editor.description: The world stops while nobody is online.

editor.label: Strict server authority
editor.description: The server checks what clients do (anti-cheat). Only turn it on when needed: play is less smooth.

editor.label: Max client latency (seconds)
editor.description: Clients that do not answer for this long are disconnected.

editor.label: Compress saves
editor.description: Saves are .zip files.

editor.label: Unload levels after (seconds)
editor.description: How long a level stays loaded after the last player left it.

editor.label: Dropped items last (minutes)
editor.description: 0 or less: forever.

editor.label: Unload settlements
editor.description: Unload player settlements while nobody is near (off = they keep working).

editor.label: Max settlements per player
editor.description: -1: no limit.

editor.label: Max settlers per settlement
editor.description: -1: no limit.

configFiles.template:
SERVER = {
	port = ${GamePort}, // [0 - 65535] Server default port
	slots = ${Slots}, // [1 - 250] Server default slots
	password = ${PrivatePassword}, // Leave blank for no password
	maxClientLatencySeconds = ${MaxClientLatencySeconds},
	pauseWhenEmpty = ${PauseWhenEmpty},
	strictServerAuthority = ${StrictServerAuthority}, // If true, server will be much more strict about what clients can do. It is strongly recommended to ONLY have this enabled if absolutely necessary
	logging = true, // If true, will create log files for each server start
	language = en,
	unloadLevelsCooldown = ${UnloadLevelsCooldown}, // The number of seconds a level will stay loaded after the last player has left it
	droppedItemsLifeMinutes = ${DroppedItemsLifeMinutes}, // Minutes that dropped items will stay in the world. 0 or less for indefinite
	unloadSettlements = ${UnloadSettlements}, // If the server should unload player settlements or keep them loaded
	maxSettlementsPerPlayer = ${MaxSettlementsPerPlayer}, // The maximum amount of settlements per player. -1 or less means infinite
	maxSettlersPerSettlement = ${MaxSettlersPerSettlement}, // The maximum amount of settlers per settlement. -1 or less means infinite
	zipSaves = ${ZipSaves}, // If true, will create new saves uncompressed
	MOTD =  // Message of the day
}

script.name: Necesse query
script.description: Reports the server online while its game port (UDP) is bound (Necesse has no query protocol).

script.name: Add the Workshop mod to the mods folder
script.description: Copies the .jar of the downloaded Workshop mod to mods/workshop-<id>.jar.

script.name: Remove the Workshop mod from the mods folder
script.description: Deletes mods/workshop-<id>.jar. On Windows the server must be stopped (it keeps its mods open).

script.name: Prepare the Linux server
script.description: Makes the bundled Java runtime executable (Steam downloads can lose the bit). Never follows symbolic links.
